summary: Forum file drop (2026-11-22, '512k_CHIRP_UV-K5_V1_ROBZYL-KO.py', SHA-256 06df9e84441162d9e65e044f7cecb3b6308c69c3d6a1cef6c3d09de5fd2086ef): community CHIRP module for Robzyl RO-KO firmware on a UV-K5 V1 with an upgraded 512 Kbit EEPROM. 0xA100-byte map, 999 channels at 0x2000, attributes 0x5E80, 16-char names 0x6280. Module reviewed: no exec/network/file/obfuscation; non-ASCII is Cyrillic. It writes without checking firmware, which would overrun a stock 8 KB EEPROM. Plan: verify against Robzyl firmware source; read-only profile gated on firmware identity.
title: Read-only profile for Robzyl RO-KO firmware on a 512K-EEPROM UV-K5 V1
